name: transitions
title: Page transitions
description: Cross-document View Transitions for every same-origin navigation (@view-transition { navigation: auto; }), with two named persistent elements (data-vt="header" and data-vt="scene") that carry across a navigation instead of cross-fading, and sameDocumentTransition(), a tiny shared guard for a same-document swap (used by Tabs and the Kantar interlude). No JavaScript is required for the cross-document behaviour; without View Transitions support, or under reduced motion, navigation and same-document swaps are simply instant.

budget.reason: Not a component (no register, no skins): a CSS file plus a small pure helper. Today 3090 bytes of JS (page.js + page.core.js); page.css (1.7 KB) is not counted against the JS budget.
